test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A solid rubber sphere weighs 6 kg when its diameter is 6 cm. Using the same material, a hollow sphere is made with outer diameter 18 cm and inner diameter 12 cm. What is its weight?
solution:
**Given:**

Solid rubber sphere weight = 6 kg and its diameter = 6 cm

Formula Used:

Volume of Solid Sphere = V = 4/3 π r³

Volume of Hollow Sphere = Vₕ = 4/3 π(r₁³ - r₂³)

**Solid sphere:**

Radius of the solid sphere = r = d/2 = 6/2 = 3 cm

Volume of the solid sphere = (4/3) πr³ = (4/3) × (22/7) × 3³ = (2376/21) cm³

Weight of the solid sphere = 6 kg

⇒ (2376/21) cm³ volume of the given material weighs 6 kg.

**Hollow sphere:**

Outer diameter of the hollow sphere = 18 cm

⇒ Outer radius of the hollow sphere = r₁ = 18/2 = 9 cm

Inner diameter of the hollow sphere = 12 cm

⇒ Inner radius of the hollow sphere = r₂ = 12/2 = 6 cm

Volume of the hollow sphere = (4/3) × π × (r₁³ – r₂³) = (4/3) × (22/7) × (9³ - 6³) = (45,144/21) cm³

Weight of the hollow sphere with volume (45,144/21) cm³ = [ (45,144/21) × 6/(2376/21) = 114 kg

**∴ Weight of the hollow sphere made with same material = 114 kg**
